content:
I am trying to use loogle with latest version of lean due to a bug in stable stopping me from installing loogle correctly on my platform, but mathlib seems to get confused when I change versions in config files to latest: https://github.com/nomeata/loogle/issues/55#issuecomment-4457685926

Any ideas?
This involves updating mathlib, which is a complicated operation you aren't expected to perform (it is literally Kim Morrison's job). Are you sure you want to do this?

Yaël Dillies said:

This involves updating mathlib, which is a complicated operation you aren't expected to perform (it is literally Kim Morrison's job). Are you sure you want to do this?

does that mean simply building from source?
oops I guess not if it's a 'complicated operation'

Yaël Dillies said:

This involves updating mathlib, which is a complicated operation you aren't expected to perform (it is literally Kim Morrison's job). Are you sure you want to do this?

Well, maybe if there is a way to see the latest version of lean that can work with mathlib, that might be enough for me

Alessandro Griseta said:

Yaël Dillies said:

This involves updating mathlib, which is a complicated operation you aren't expected to perform (it is literally Kim Morrison's job). Are you sure you want to do this?

Well, maybe if there is a way to see the latest version of lean that can work with mathlib, that might be enough for me

So here it is: https://github.com/nomeata/loogle/blob/master/lean-toolchain
This should be possible by building a 'decoy' version of leanprover/lean4:v4.30.0-rc1 from source with everything the same apart from the single patch for my platform.
